scopeNote: The GLM/M3 Tribunal covers predecessor full S8 subject ba8c411f. Later bounded deltas resolve defects found by repeated clean-checkout qualification; Codex locally reviewed the exact final subject using those discriminating failures and reruns. Unavailable attempts are disclosed but not counted.

findings.summary: Bounded worker-to-host service concurrency and added a flood negative control.
Propagated invocation cancellation and the original host signal into engine dispatch, with identity, abort, and fail-stop controls.
Preserved external AsyncIterable event streams and bounded abandoned-stream buffering.
Expanded receipt redaction for URL credentials and sensitive query parameters.
Added NFC portable-key normalization and filesystem-discriminating collision coverage.
Revocation, generation validation, snapshot TOCTOU, wildcard resource, and performance claims contradicted exact source and discriminating gates.
AbortSignal cross-dispatch claims confused a read-only signal with its undisclosed AbortController; the host dispatcher identity test proves the actual boundary.
Cryptographic containment of already-full-trust same-user code is outside the explicit consent model and would not reduce that code’s authority.
Early iterator return is explicit abandonment and correctly cancels/fail-stops rather than falsely claiming delivery of later events.
Generated/physical ownership, fixed surface oracles, roadmap/ledgers, and the non-polluting clean-checkout harness now agree and discriminate all observed defects.
